build_drop_path: build a stochastic depth drop path layer that randomly drops entire residual paths during training
create_graph_drop_path: create a graph-aware drop path module that considers batch indices when dropping paths for graph data
use_equivariant_dropout: use an equivariant dropout module that applies dropout to irreducible representations using e3nn tensor products
apply_equivariant_scalars_dropout: apply equivariant dropout only to scalar irreps while preserving non-scalar features in the tensor
implement_spherical_harmonics_dropout: implement dropout for spherical harmonics arrays with optional graph-aware batch dropping support
